faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about Miaoyou

q1.question: Will the mailbox account expire?
q1.answer: No. Mailbox accounts created with Miaoyou are permanently valid, you can log in anytime with your email and password.

q2.question: Can I still log in after changing devices?
q2.answer: Yes. As long as you remember your email address and password, you can log in from any browser on any device.

q3.question: How long are emails kept?
q3.answer: Read emails are automatically deleted 24 hours after being received to free up storage space. Unread emails are kept for up to 90 days and then automatically deleted. Please save important content in time.

q4.question: What if I forget my password?
q4.answer: Unfortunately, for security reasons, we cannot provide password recovery. Please be sure to back up your email and password.
